scope: One real-game primary-theme defect and mechanism-directed controls, judged before probing these controls. This is a development set, not representative classifier accuracy. Bounds are local material, not Stockfish evaluation.

cases.why: The discovered queen check forbids Rxd7. Rxc2 instead uncovers Rxa7, trading queens while retaining the captured rook. Discovered Check is the root mechanism, not a loose rook or a future queen capture.
The bishop's newly uncovered check prevents the equal rook recapture. The capturing rook can escape after the check is answered.
There is no recapturer; the rook was already free. Do not promote the incidental discovery over its capture.
Rxc2 wins the checking queen; there is no screened queen on a7 to compensate. A check cannot forbid capturing its source.
The knight cannot recapture on f4 while in check, but the king can. Cover legal king captures, not just the forbidden nominal recapturer.

Qc2 itself is the discovered checker and blocks Bb1. Removing Qc2 uncovers another check, so this single-checker counterfactual cannot isolate the mechanism. In the real Rxc2 Bxc2 exchange Black gains only 100 local material, not the raw rook's 500. This is not a whole-position negative; the older hanging-piece valuation remains a separate gap.
Removing Qc2 would change support of c3 as well as remove check. That counterfactual cannot establish that the discovered check made the capture work.

Qc2 also lies on the b1-h7 bishop ray toward its own king. Removing it could change king safety in later exchanges, even while another blocker remains. Abstain from this counterfactual, not a claim that the whole move loses.
